PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: fx-golden-fire
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Atmosphere/VFX guard: transfer only light falloff, particle behavior, haze density, ember/gold color relationships, and cinematic exposure. Keep the effect content and compositing requirements controlled by this row.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain; explicitly requested golden luminous-VFX behavior only.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
FX-GOLDEN-FIRE — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: CINEMATIC VFX, PARTICLES, LIGHT, TRANSFORMATION, AND MOTION REFERENCE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Dedicated photorealistic production reference for the golden fire of transformed Hell during the Harrowing of Hell — the sacred successor to the cold blue torch-flame that once lit the fortress of the dead. After Jesus strikes the ground with the sword of light and the shockwave remakes the prison, blue flame becomes golden fire: living divine combustion that no longer threatens or tortures but consecrates. This asset isolates the fire itself as a practical and VFX lighting hero element for continuity across the transformed inner chamber, the white-marble pillars, the path of ascent, and any torch sconces or free-burning braziers that survive the metamorphosis.

Subject: pure golden fire as sacred phenomenon, not ordinary campfire orange and not cartoon CGI flame. Color core is bright near-white gold and pure white at the hottest heart, blooming outward through true gold (#FFD700), warm amber (#FFBF00), soft honey, and pale lemon at the translucent edges. Flame tongues rise with elegant vertical energy and gentle lateral sway, layered in translucent sheets so deeper glow shows through outer veils. Motion feel is alive and purposeful — a living presence of grace — never frantic, never hellish thrashing. Embers and micro-sparks of gold lift upward in slow luminous drift, dissolving into warm volumetric haze rather than black sooty smoke.

Physical behavior and light physics: the fire casts warm key light onto nearby stone that has already turned to pale white marble, throwing soft amber fill into recessed surfaces and gold specular highlights along polished edges. Color temperature reads roughly 4500K–6500K mixed divine warmth — gold dominant with pure white radiance in the core — clearly distinct from the earlier cold blue torch light near 2000K with royal-blue (#4169E1) cast and red underglow. Shadow edges are soft and luminous, not harsh or green-tinted. Heat shimmer subtly warps air immediately above the flame. No toxic green, no cold cyan, no sulfuric yellow of damnation; this is purified, perfume-sweet golden fire that belongs to the liberation beat when poison air becomes perfume and black stone becomes white marble.

Material context and mounts: show the fire both free-standing as a brazier of transformed flame and mounted in ancient iron torch sconces fixed to white marble pillars — the metal of the sconces still faintly scarred from the old fortress, but now washed in gold light so corrosion reads as aged bronze-iron rather than active rot. Fuel bed, if visible, is clean glowing coal and ash turned pale and luminous, not black char. Occasional thin wisps of warm amber vapor replace the old blue smoke. Floor and pillar fragments of white marble catch caustic golden patterns from the flickering light.

Framing and camera: medium close production-reference framing on the flame mass itself as the hero subject, with enough surrounding architecture to establish scale and continuity — edge of a white marble column, a sconce, a short stretch of transformed chamber floor. 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen sensibility, roughly 50–85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field so the fire core is razor-sharp while distant chamber recedes into soft warm glow. Slight low-to-eye angle so the flame rises into frame with dignity. Photoreal live-action plate quality suitable for lighting reference and VFX plate matching: subsurface translucency in flame sheets, realistic turbulence, physically plausible bloom and soft volumetric scatter, filmic highlight roll-off without digital clipping artifacts.

Environment and atmosphere: Hell’s inner chamber after the miracle — black stone already converted to white marble, warm amber air, residual fine dust motes illuminated as golden stars in suspension. Far background may hold faint cooler residual shadow only as memory of the former prison, never competing with the golden fire as primary light source. No guardians, no red-fire eyes, no blue torches remaining in this dedicated state asset. No modern objects, no fuel canisters, no electric lamps, no logos, no readable text, no watermarks, no UI, no borders, no captions.

Continuity locks: golden fire is the terminal state of former blue flame after Jesus’ shockwave transformation; palette locked to ethereal golds, warm amber, pure white divine radiance; atmosphere warm, fragrant, peaceful-triumphant rather than violent; photoreal biblical epic tone, sacred and reverent, never gore, never camp fantasy fireballs. Repeat: blue flame becomes golden fire; white marble context; warm amber illumination; no modern elements; no text overlays.
